subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Hydatidiform Mole: Complete, Partial and Snowstorm Appearance

steps.tx: Abnormal fertilisation producing swollen chorionic villi and no normal fetus forms a **hydatidiform mole**. It is the commonest gestational trophoblastic disease. Evacuation and hormone surveillance cure the great majority without chemotherapy. Incidence runs near one in a thousand pregnancies in Western series and higher in South East Asian populations.
steps.say: Hydatidiform mole produces swollen villi without a normal fetus and usually cures with evacuation.

steps.tx: A mole with only paternal chromosomes, usually forty six XX from an empty egg, is a **complete mole**. No fetus exists and villi swell diffusely like grapes. Malignant sequelae follow in about fifteen to twenty percent. The genotype is usually 46,XX with both sets paternal, arising when an empty egg is fertilised by one duplicated sperm.
steps.say: A complete mole carries only paternal chromosomes and no fetus, with diffuse grape like villi.

steps.tx: A mole with three chromosome sets and an abnormal fetus present is a **partial mole**. Triploidy from two sperm fertilising one egg produces focal villous swelling. Malignant change is rare, under five percent. The fetus, when present, is growth restricted with multiple anomalies and rarely survives to delivery.
steps.say: A partial mole is triploid with a fetus present and rarely becomes malignant.

steps.tx: The classic ultrasound picture of innumerable cystic spaces filling the uterus is the **snowstorm appearance**. Modern early scanning more often shows a complex intrauterine mass before this develops. Very high hCG and a uterus large for dates support the diagnosis. Theca lutein cysts and a uterus large for dates accompany the picture when hCG climbs highest.
steps.say: The snowstorm appearance fills the uterus with cystic spaces on ultrasound in molar pregnancy.

steps.tx: Excessive vomiting, early pre-eclampsia before twenty weeks and thyrotoxicosis features point to mole through **hCG excess effects**. The hormone level often exceeds one hundred thousand units. These systemic features resolve after evacuation. Pre-eclampsia before 20 weeks is almost diagnostic of a mole until disproved, because ordinary pre-eclampsia comes later.
steps.say: hCG excess in mole causes severe vomiting, early pre-eclampsia and thyrotoxic features.

steps.tx: Histology distinguishes mole types by villous change and trophoblast proliferation, aided by **p57 staining**. Complete moles lose this maternally expressed stain, partial moles retain it. Accurate typing guides surveillance length. Immunostain p57 is absent in complete mole because the gene is expressed only from the maternal copy.
steps.say: p57 staining separates complete moles, which lose it, from partial moles retaining it.

steps.tx: Bleeding in early pregnancy with passage of grape like vesicles is nearly diagnostic, called **vesicle passage**. Most moles today are diagnosed by scan before this classic sign appears. Any vesicles passed are sent for histology. Histology of any products of conception after miscarriage catches the moles that scan missed.
steps.say: Passage of grape like vesicles nearly diagnoses mole, though scans now detect most earlier.

steps.tx: Suction evacuation under ultrasound guidance is the treatment of choice, performed as **suction evacuation**. Oxytocics are avoided before evacuation lest trophoblast embolise, then used after. Tissue always goes for histological confirmation. Ergometrine and oxytocin are withheld until the uterus is empty to avoid pushing trophoblast into veins.
steps.say: Suction evacuation treats mole, with oxytocics avoided until evacuation is underway.

steps.tx: Registration with a specialist centre and serial hormone follow up are mandatory after evacuation, termed **central registration**. This safety net catches the minority progressing to neoplasia while hormone remains measurable. Contraception during follow up prevents diagnostic confusion. Follow up lasts six months from evacuation if hCG normalises within eight weeks, longer when it falls slowly.
steps.say: Central registration with serial hormone follow up catches molar progression to neoplasia.
